events.title: DeepSeek R1 released
events.summary: DeepSeek released R1 on January 20, 2025 — an open-weight reasoning model matching o1-class performance at a fraction of the training cost.
events.about: DeepSeek R1 shook the AI industry: strong math and coding results with open weights and transparent training details. It triggered a market reaction over inference economics and proved Chinese labs could ship frontier reasoning models competitively.

narrative.whyChosen: DeepSeek R1 disrupted assumptions about who could build frontier reasoning models.
narrative.whyImportant: Open reasoning weights challenged closed [API] dominance and pricing models.
narrative.problemSolved: Teams wanted o1-class reasoning without proprietary [API] lock-in or extreme costs.

events.title: Tailwind CSS 4.0 released
events.summary: Adam Wathan released Tailwind CSS 4.0 on January 22, 2025 — a ground-up rewrite with a [Rust]-powered engine and CSS-first configuration.
events.about: Tailwind 4 replaced PostCSS config files with `@import "tailwindcss"` in CSS — automatic content detection, native cascade layers, and builds up to 100x faster on incremental compiles. It redefined utility-first CSS for the modern platform.

narrative.whyChosen: Tailwind 4's Oxide engine made utility-first CSS dramatically faster to build.
narrative.whyImportant: CSS-first config and native platform features set a new baseline for CSS frameworks.
narrative.problemSolved: Tailwind 3's JavaScript config and PostCSS pipeline slowed large monorepo builds.

events.title: OpenAI o3-mini released
events.summary: OpenAI released o3-mini on January 31, 2025 — a cost-efficient reasoning model with adjustable effort levels, available to all ChatGPT users including free tier.
events.about: o3-mini delivered o3-class STEM reasoning at o1-mini pricing — tripling Plus rate limits and answering DeepSeek R1's open-weight challenge weeks after R1's launch. It shipped with function calling, structured outputs, and web search before full o3 arrived in April.

narrative.whyChosen: o3-mini brought frontier reasoning to free ChatGPT users at mini-model cost.
narrative.whyImportant: Adjustable reasoning effort made test-time compute tunable per task.
narrative.problemSolved: Developers wanted o3-class math and coding without full o3 latency and price.
